hero.title: Mint Masala: Where Global Flavors Meet Modern Elegance
hero.subtitle: Discover a chic, trendy culinary journey featuring the best of Indian, Tandoor, Chinese, and Continental cuisines.

about.title: Unveiling the Essence of Mint Masala
about.paragraph1: At Mint Masala, we've crafted a dining experience that's both chic and trendy, blending the popular and sought-after Indian, Tandoor, and Chinese offerings with a delightful sprinkling of Continental dishes. It's a place where the fiery confluence of Indian spices gracefully shares your table with the gentle nudges of Chinese herbs and seasonings.
about.paragraph2: We invite you to immerse yourself in a vibrant multi-cuisine adventure, designed for modern diners who appreciate both tradition and innovation. Every dish at Mint Masala is a testament to our passion for exquisite flavors and a memorable culinary journey, all served within an ambiance that's as inviting as our food.
